name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Full Cube
proof: Query the $n$ coordinates in the same fixed order at every node. This is a prefix-$k$ tree of depth $n$, so $\mathrm{PL}_k\geq n$. No Littlestone tree on an $n$-coordinate class has depth greater than $n$, and $\mathrm{PL}_k\leq\mathrm L$, giving equality.
references: Database-defined variant; the comparison $\mathrm{PL}_k\leq\mathrm L$ is Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey
